name: input-group
useFor: Use to attach context to a field: a fixed suffix (@inboxmail.com as a segment), a search glyph, a show or copy button, a character count under a textarea, or the live state of a check (spinner, green check-circle, red x-circle). Put InputGroupInput or InputGroupTextarea inside, then InputGroupAddon at inline-start, inline-end, block-start or block-end.
constraints: Putting a separate Input inside the group
More than one action at each end
A suffix that people can edit
source: Figma 427:2715: the Email card's handle field with @inboxmail.com and the handle check states (checking, Available, Not Available) in Modal States
